HOY-2026-011.title: Senior Backend Engineer — Payments Platform
HOY-2026-011.location: Bengaluru (Hoysala Digital Centre, Bellandur) — hybrid, min. 3 days on-site

must_haves.text: 5+ years of professional backend engineering experience on the JVM (Java and/or Kotlin) in high-volume production environments.
Strong experience with Spring Boot, Kafka and PostgreSQL/Oracle.
Hands-on experience running containerized workloads on Kubernetes in a public cloud (we run on AWS).
A track record of designing distributed systems for correctness under failure (idempotency, retries, outbox patterns).
Fluent professional English.

nice_to_haves.text: Payments domain experience: UPI switch or TPAP integrations, IMPS/NEFT/RTGS, ISO 8583, ISO 20022 (pacs/camt), or card processing.
Kotlin in production.
Experience in a bank, PSP or fintech operating under RBI/NPCI regulation.
Familiarity with RBI master directions on digital payment security controls.

responsibilities: Design, build and operate JVM microservices for UPI, IMPS and NEFT/RTGS payment flows, from initiation through reconciliation.
Deliver NPCI compliance and feature mandates (UPI Lite, AutoPay, RuPay credit on UPI) on unforgiving external deadlines.
Drive the ISO 8583 and ISO 20022 message-transformation services to full production coverage.
Work with Kafka-based event streaming as the backbone of the platform.
Own non-functional requirements: idempotency, exactly-once semantics, back-pressure, four-nines availability, and RBI incident-reporting timelines.
Participate in the team's on-call rotation and continuously improve runbooks.
Coach mid-level engineers through design and code review.

HOY-2026-014.title: Site Reliability Engineer — Platform Reliability
HOY-2026-014.location: Bengaluru or Chennai — hybrid, min. 3 days on-site

must_haves.text: 4+ years in SRE, DevOps or platform engineering roles running production systems.
Deep working knowledge of Kubernetes and at least one major cloud (AWS preferred).
Solid Terraform experience and Linux fundamentals.
Proficiency scripting/programming in Go or Python.
Hands-on experience with Prometheus-style monitoring and incident management.
Fluent professional English.

nice_to_haves.text: Experience in banking, NBFC or another regulated, high-availability environment; familiarity with RBI IT outsourcing and cyber-resilience directions.
Kafka, Vault, service-mesh (Istio/Linkerd) operations.
CKA/CKS certification.
Experience introducing SLOs to an organization for the first time.

responsibilities: Define and operationalize SLOs/error budgets with product teams.
Build and maintain infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) for our AWS and on-prem Kubernetes estates, within RBI data-localisation requirements.
Extend our observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, OpenTelemetry).
Automate away recurring operational work in Go or Python.
Join a 24/7 on-call rotation across Bengaluru and Chennai; lead blameless post-incident reviews with RBI-reportable incidents handled to the clock.
Run RBI-mandated DR drills and chaos/failover exercises for critical payment systems, with audit-ready evidence.

HOY-2026-017.title: AI Engineer — Generative AI Center of Excellence
HOY-2026-017.division: Technology — Data & AI (GenAI Center of Excellence)
HOY-2026-017.location: Bengaluru (Hoysala Digital Centre, Bellandur) — hybrid, min. 3 days on-site

must_haves.text: 3+ years of professional software or ML engineering experience in Python.
Hands-on production experience with LLM applications — RAG, structured output/function calling, prompt and context design (not only notebooks or POCs).
Experience with vector stores (e.g. pgvector, OpenSearch, Chroma, Pinecone) and embedding models.
Demonstrated approach to evaluating LLM systems beyond "it looks good" — golden sets, metrics, regression testing.
Solid engineering fundamentals: testing, CI/CD, containers, code review.
Fluent professional English.

nice_to_haves.text: Experience in BFSI or another regulated industry; familiarity with RBI's FREE-AI framework, DPDP Act obligations, or model risk management.
Indic-language NLP experience (transliteration handling, code-mixed queries, Indic embeddings).
Agent/tool-use architectures in production; open-weight model serving (vLLM).
MLOps stack experience (MLflow, model registries, feature stores).
Contributions to open-source AI tooling.

responsibilities: Build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines over the bank's document estate: ingestion, chunking, embedding, retrieval tuning, grounded generation with citations.

Design and automate evaluation: golden sets, LLM-as-judge with human calibration, regression gates in CI before any prompt or model change ships — including vernacular (Hindi/Kannada/Tamil) query sets.
Implement guardrails (input/output filtering, PII redaction under the DPDP Act, groundedness checks) and the logging needed for model risk management.
Integrate models via our internal model gateway (hosted LLM APIs and open-weight models on our own GPUs); optimize for cost and latency.
Ship production Python services (FastAPI, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions).
Pair with use-case teams across the bank to take pilots to production.

HOY-2026-019.title: Quantitative Researcher — Market Risk Models
HOY-2026-019.division: Risk Management — Market & Counterparty Risk Models
HOY-2026-019.location: Bengaluru (with periodic travel to the Mumbai dealing room)

must_haves.text: M.Sc./M.Tech or PhD in a quantitative discipline (mathematics, physics, statistics, econometrics, quantitative finance or similar).
Strong grounding in probability theory, stochastic processes and statistics.
Working knowledge of derivatives pricing (discounting, curve construction, Black-Scholes-type models, Greeks).
Strong Python; ability to read and contribute to C++ is a plus we test for.
Ability to explain quantitative results to non-quant stakeholders in fluent professional English.

nice_to_haves.text: Direct experience with the RBI market-risk framework, FRTB (IMA or SA), IRRBB, or counterparty credit risk (SA-CCR, internal EPE models).
Experience in a bank's treasury, risk or model-validation quant team, or a rates/FX quant role at a primary dealer.
Experience presenting models during RBI inspections or to ALCO.
FRM/CQF; publications or open-source work in quantitative finance.

responsibilities: Develop and maintain VaR/ES models for the trading book (G-Sec, SDL, OIS, FX), including risk-factor modeling, P&L attribution tests and non-modellable risk factor treatment under the FRTB-aligned parallel run.
Design and run backtesting frameworks; investigate breaches and drive remediation.
Build and improve pricing and sensitivity models for linear rates, FX and vanilla-option products used in risk calculations, consistent with FIMMDA valuation norms.
Implement research code in Python (production handover in C++ together with the quant development team).
Document models to internal model-governance standards and present to Model Validation, ALCO and RBI inspection teams.
Partner with Treasury on IRRBB scenario design (EVE/NII sensitivity under the prescribed shocks).

HOY-2026-021.title: Quantitative Developer — Treasury & Markets Technology
HOY-2026-021.location: Bengaluru (Hoysala Digital Centre, Bellandur) — hybrid, min. 4 days on-site

must_haves.text: 4+ years of professional C++ development (C++17 or later) on Linux in performance-sensitive systems.
Strong Python and experience exposing C++ to Python (pybind11, Cython or similar).
Solid numerical programming fundamentals: floating-point behavior, stability, vectorization, profiling.
Rigorous testing habits for numerical code.
Fluent professional English and the communication skills to work directly with trading and risk stakeholders.

nice_to_haves.text: Knowledge of fixed-income mathematics: discounting, yield curves, swaps, FX forwards, vanilla options and Greeks; familiarity with Indian market conventions (G-Sec day counts, FBIL benchmarks, CCIL settlement).
Experience with QuantLib or an in-house pricing library at a bank, primary dealer, prop-trading firm or exchange-adjacent shop.
Algorithmic differentiation (AAD) experience.
Low-latency or HPC background (SIMD, cache-aware data structures, multithreading).

responsibilities: Extend Rampart's C++ core: G-Sec and OIS curve construction, instrument pricing, sensitivities (algorithmic differentiation), scenario engines.
Maintain and improve the pybind11-based Python API that quants and risk managers script against.
Profile and optimize hot paths — intraday risk runs must complete within strict time budgets on a fixed compute envelope.
Harden numerical code: unit and regression test suites, reproducible builds, golden-number testing against model specifications and FIMMDA valuation checks.
Work daily with dealers, market-risk quants and the ALM desk on priorities.
Improve the platform: CMake build, CI pipelines, Linux runtime environment.

HOY-2026-023.title: HR Business Partner — Technology
HOY-2026-023.location: Bengaluru (Hoysala Digital Centre, Bellandur) — hybrid, min. 3 days on-site

must_haves.text: 6+ years of progressive HR experience of which 3+ as an HR Business Partner or HR Manager for a substantial client group.
Demonstrable working knowledge of Indian employment law in practice (Karnataka S&E Act, POSH Act, PF/ESI/gratuity, contract labour) and disciplinary-inquiry processes.
Experience supporting reorganisations, insourcing/rebadging or large change programs.
A data-driven working style — comfortable building an argument from HR analytics.
Professional fluency in English; Kannada and/or Hindi strongly preferred.

nice_to_haves.text: Experience partnering with technology/engineering organisations or GCCs.
Darwinbox or Workday experience.
Experience in banking, NBFC or another regulated sector.
Certification in coaching or organisational development; SHRM/CIPD credentials.

responsibilities: Partner with Technology directors on org design, role architecture and strategic workforce planning for the Garuda transition, including vendor-to-bank insourcing (rebadging) of engineering roles.

Guide managers through complex employee-relations cases (performance improvement plans, disciplinary inquiries, long-term illness) compliant with the Karnataka Shops & Establishments Act and the bank's HR policy framework.
Support statutory compliance in partnership with the compliance team: POSH Act processes (including ICC case support), PF/gratuity/ESI questions, contract- workforce governance.
Use people analytics (attrition, engagement, internal mobility, pay-equity data) to ground advice in evidence — attrition in our technology population is the single biggest people-risk to Garuda.
Run the annual talent, performance and reward cycles for your client groups, including campus (NIT/IIT/IIIT) and lateral onboarding cohorts.
Coach engineering managers, many of whom are first-time people leaders.

HOY-2026-025.title: Engineering Manager — Core Banking Modernization
HOY-2026-025.location: Bengaluru (Hoysala Digital Centre, Bellandur) — hybrid, min. 4 days on-site

must_haves.text: 8+ years in software engineering, of which 3+ years managing engineering teams (including managing at least ~8 engineers and hiring experience).
Demonstrated delivery of a large migration or modernization program in a complex estate (core systems, high-integrity data, many consumers).
Enough technical depth to challenge designs: distributed systems, data consistency, API/event integration patterns.
Experience with senior stakeholder and vendor/SI management.
Fluent professional English.

nice_to_haves.text: Banking or NBFC experience; familiarity with RBI IT examinations and change-risk governance.
Legacy CBS coexistence experience (Finacle/BaNCS/Flexcube customisation landscapes alongside cloud services, CDC-based sync).
Experience leading distributed teams across cities.
Experience with strangler-fig migrations and event-driven architectures.

responsibilities: Lead, grow and coach three cross-functional teams (~22 engineers, mixed seniority, two cities); hire with intent in a brutal talent market and develop your engineers.
Own delivery of the account/ledger migration roadmap: sequencing, risk management, dependency management with 15+ consuming systems.
Drive engineering quality: you are accountable for the reliability of both the legacy and target stacks during coexistence.
Manage senior stakeholders: program leadership, Operations, Risk, and the system-integrator vendor relationship (AMC and change-request commercials).
Balance transformation work against run-the-bank demands within a fixed budget.
Shape the target operating model as legacy workloads wind down, including reskilling paths for CBS-customisation engineers.

HOY-2026-027.title: Product Manager — Mobile Banking
HOY-2026-027.location: Bengaluru (Hoysala Digital Centre, Bellandur) — hybrid, min. 3 days on-site

must_haves.text: 5+ years of product management on consumer digital products, of which 2+ on a high-traffic mobile app.
A demonstrated experimentation practice: you can point to decisions changed by A/B tests or research you ran.
Fluency with product analytics tools (Amplitude, CleverTap, Mixpanel or similar) and the statistics to interpret them honestly.
Experience shipping with in-house engineering squads in an agile setting.
Excellent stakeholder communication in fluent professional English.

nice_to_haves.text: Payments, banking or fintech domain knowledge (UPI ecosystem, Account Aggregator, video-KYC, digital-lending guidelines).
Kannada, Hindi or Tamil language skills (customer research is largely vernacular).
Experience designing for first-time internet users / vernacular-first users.
A technical or data background.

responsibilities: Own the roadmap and OKRs for the Payments & Daily Banking domain in the app.

Run continuous discovery: customer interviews (largely in Kannada, Hindi and Tamil), funnel analysis, painted-door and A/B experiments (we use Amplitude, CleverTap and an in-house experimentation platform).
Ship iteratively with your squads: write crisp problem statements, slice scope, make evidence-based trade-offs.
Exploit the Account Aggregator framework to build money-management features that wallet competitors can't easily copy.

Balance innovation with the realities of a bank: NPCI circular timelines, RBI digital-lending and payment-security guidelines, fraud patterns (mule accounts, social-engineering scams) and vernacular usability.
Align stakeholders across Fraud, Compliance, Operations and Branch Banking.
